lead.headline: Warren loses Rodgers; Footballers take Tuten's backup
lead.deck: Claims are done. Pittsburgh start Rudolph on Friday and ESPN has not repriced it; Tuten is a weekend call.
lead.body: Bad news first. Pittsburgh benched Aaron Rodgers overnight and Mason Rudolph starts against Denver on Friday; Warren's 14.8 has not moved since. Forbes now says sit him, and NBC expects the Steelers to run more. Tuten's ankle is a high sprain he has carried since Week 8. Coen will watch Wednesday and Thursday and said only 'We'll see'. At 02:11 Footballers claimed Chris Rodriguez Jr., the back who starts if Tuten sits. The lineup is still the projection lineup, and ESPN calls it 50-50. Two checks are left: Warren's number before Friday 14:00, and Tuten at 10:30 Sunday.
